findings.message: "been": not an approved form of BE (only be, is, are, was, were). Rewrite without it.
"-ing" verb form "checking": not permitted. Rewrite with a simple tense ("when you do", not "when doing").
Semicolon: "He who reads the cache file assumes it is always valid JSON; if it isn't, the whole com..."
Contraction "isn't": write the words in full.
Gender-specific pronoun "He": the rules do not permit he/she. Use "the operator", "you", "they".
Possible multi-word noun of 4 words: "whole command fails instead". Max 3 — use prepositions or hyphens (2.2).
"-ing" word "falling": permitted only if it is a technical noun or a modifier in one ("wiring diagram"). Confirm, else rewrite.
Latin abbreviation "etc.": use "for example", "that is", or rewrite.
"-ing" word "installing": permitted only if it is a technical noun or a modifier in one ("wiring diagram"). Confirm, else rewrite.
Contraction "We'd": write the words in full.
"-ing" verb form "doing": not permitted. Rewrite with a simple tense ("when you do", not "when doing").
